features.feature: A client opens from the Threads list or Thread actions → Open <client>, on tabs Overview, Calls, Tasks, People (each with its count, none when zero), Profile
Overview shows About <client> (Edit) and a card per thread: stage, calls, last call, stories done, open tasks per pile and late, the last decisions, risks (no response first), open questions
Calls lists every call of the client's threads, newest first, with its threads and "no minutes yet"
Tasks shows the Tasks piles for the client's threads, Others folded
Profile edits name, other names, mail domains, Your own company, logo, and makes a thread for the client
A client without threads can be removed after a confirmation; one with threads says to move or delete them first; a removed client's link says "This client is gone"
The user's company shows as "<name> · your company"; its people count as colleagues, never as a client's people
Organisations that aren't clients (partners, vendors) are kept with `echoctl org add/set/remove`; an account with threads can't be removed
